title: Vacation Package Products: Deposits, Booking Distances and the Agency Service Fee
content:
The figures below are the published schedule for the six Vacation Package Products. They fix, product by product, the agency booking service fee charged per traveller, the deposit taken per traveller at booking, the deposit expressed as a share of the package price where the product takes a share rather than a flat amount, whether a reduced promotional deposit may be taken instead of the standard one and at what amount, the minimum calendar days between booking and departure for the product to be sold, and the furthest ahead of departure, in calendar days, that the product may be booked.

## Schedule

| Product | Agency service fee per traveller | Deposit per traveller | Deposit as a share of price | Reduced promotional deposit | Promotional deposit per traveller | Advance-purchase distance | Booking window |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | 29.95 USD | 150.00 USD | 0 per cent | permitted | 49.00 USD | 7 calendar days | 365 calendar days |
| Flex Bundle Package | 24.95 USD | 200.00 USD | 0 per cent | permitted | 79.00 USD | 3 calendar days | 365 calendar days |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | 19.95 USD | 300.00 USD | 15 per cent | permitted | 99.00 USD | 14 calendar days | 400 calendar days |
| Escorted Tour Package | 24.95 USD | 400.00 USD | 20 per cent | not permitted | 0.00 USD | 30 calendar days | 450 calendar days |
| Ocean Cruise Package | 34.95 USD | 500.00 USD | 25 per cent | not permitted | 0.00 USD | 45 calendar days | 540 calendar days |
| Luxury Collection Package | 0.00 USD | 1000.00 USD | 30 per cent | not permitted | 0.00 USD | 21 calendar days | 540 calendar days |

## Notes to the schedule

A share of nil against a product means that product publishes no percentage deposit and its deposit figure is the flat amount per traveller alone. A promotional deposit figure of nil against a product means that product publishes no reduced promotional deposit, consistent with the entry against it in the promotional-deposit column.

The advance-purchase distance and the booking window are the two ends of one measurement, both counted in calendar days between the booking and the departure: the first is the nearest departure a product may be sold for, the second the furthest. On the Flex Bundle Package the pair runs from 3 calendar days to 365 calendar days; on the Ocean Cruise Package it runs from 45 calendar days to 540 calendar days.

Where a reader needs only the ranking, the deposit per traveller rises across the six Vacation Package Products from 150.00 USD to 1000.00 USD, while the agency service fee does not follow that ranking: it stands highest on the Ocean Cruise Package at 34.95 USD and falls to nil on the Luxury Collection Package.
